findings.evidence: docs/doc_struc.md lists docs/cross-cutting/threat-model.md and docs/cross-cutting/data-handling.md with recipe: docs/cross-cutting/security.md, i.e. security.md is their template. Both sibling docs contain top-level '### Audit Trail' and '### Monitoring and Observability' sections (threat-model.md lines 51 and 74; data-handling.md lines 82 and 151). security.md itself has no Audit Trail or Monitoring and Observability section anywhere in its content, and neither term appears in the document.
findings.message: security.md is the recipe/template for threat-model.md and data-handling.md, but is missing the Audit Trail and Monitoring and Observability sections that both sibling documents generated from the same recipe include as required top-level sections.
